title: Score a point
description: In any sport or board game, score a single point. You must follow all the rules of the game.

title: Water pong
description: Throw a ball into a cup of water from at least 2 metres away. The cup and ball may be makeshift.

title: Melt something
description: Heat any solid object until it becomes liquid.

title: Cry
description: Produce a single tear by whatever means necessary.

title: Get thanked
description: Get 5 different strangers to thank you verbally.

title: Tell the time
description: Start a timer. Without looking at any clocks or other timed events, stop the timer after 5 minutes, within half a minute.

title: Ace a maths minute
description: Achieve full marks on a standard maths minute.

title: Fail a maths minute spectacularly
description: Answer every question in a [standard maths minute](https://webmathminute.com/online) (no timer). Your answers must have no digits in common with the correct answer.

title: Balancing act
description: Place a pebble on your head and walk the full length of the longest street on your block without it falling off. You may not attach the pebble to your head or hair.

title: Advertise JL:OX
description: Make a leaflet or poster for Jet Lag: Oxford, including our logo and this entire challenge description, then display it in public. Remove it before leaving the region - do not litter!

title: Choreograph a dance
description: Choreograph and perform a dance. The dance must contain 10 different moves, and all teammates in your region must participate

title: Forge a graffito
description: Find and trace a piece of graffiti. If you cannot trace it, recreate it as accurately as possible.

title: Litter picking
description: Find five pieces of litter in the region and put them in the correct bin. The bin does not need to be in the region, but the litter must be found in it. You may not split litter into more pieces.

title: Critique some architecture
description: Go to the largest building bordering your region and say or write five things you like about it and five things you would change about it.

title: High five
description: High five a stranger. You may not ask them to high five you.

title: Post a letter
description: Write a letter with at least 100 words describing your surroundings. Do not post it without valid postage - this is littering.

title: Compose a poem
description: Write a poem describing your surroundings, at least 30 words and 4 lines long, obeying a consistent meter or rhyme scheme. Free verse is not allowed.

title: Ascend a hundred steps
description: Consecutively or not, one player must ascend a total of 100 steps.

title: Make a trade
description: Without using money, successfully trade something with a stranger.

title: Fly a paper aeroplane
description: Make and throw a paper aeroplane. It must travel at least 30 feet horizontally.

title: Find today's date
description: Find today's date in writing. You may not write it yourselves.

title: Charge your phone
description: Through whatever means, get your phone to successfully charge without using items you already have.

title: Wear a non-hat hat
description: Wear something on your head that was not made to be headgear. It must remain on your head until you complete your next challenge, otherwise you are instantly KO'd.

title: Spell a street name
description: Find every letter in the full name of any street in the area on other signs. The signs must be outside, you may not use street name signs, and you may not use the same sign twice.

title: Land consecutive bottle flips
description: Flip a partially filled bottle so that it completes a somersault and lands upright. Do this twice in a row.

title: Score a goal
description: Make some goalposts at most 8 metres apart and kick a ball through them from a distance of 12 metres.

title: Crown your ally
description: Craft a crown out of any material, and bestow it to a teammate ceremonially. They must wear this crown until they claim a new region. If they stop for any reason, repeat the ceremony at the original location

title: Exercise class
description: Do 5 cartwheels, 10 burpees, 15 squats or 20 starjumps.

title: Count out your steps
description: Estimate the number of steps it will take you to walk from one edge of your region to another non-adjacent edge. Walk it in exactly this many steps. You get one guess and one attempt.

title: Design a flag
description: Design a flag for the area. It must include at least 3 colours and at least 3 features.

title: Hug the trees
description: Hug every tree in the region. There must be at least one.

title: Trace silhouettes
description: Find something at least 1 metre tall casting a shadow onto dirt, sand, or gravel. Trace its shadow's outline.

title: Mimic some models
description: Find a person on an advert or poster and mimic their pose and facial expression for 30 seconds.

title: Propogate a plant
description: Find a small wild plant and take a cutting, plant it, then water it.

title: Make a putt
description: Putt a ball into a cup from at least 2 metres away. The cup, ball, and club may be makeshift, but the club must be at least 60cm long.

title: Talk without fifth glyphs
description: On public sitting apparatus, then impart your opinions about a topic of your choosing, lasting a minimum of 30s. No words you say may contain 'e'. Writing flashcards is okay.

title: Parrot an animal sound
description: Hear then copy a sound vocalised by a non-human animal.

title: Shout it out
description: Stand at least 10 metres apart, with a road, river, or path between you. Get a teammate to repeat a sentence from the Nonsense Generator by shouting it to them.

title: Experience paredolia
description: Take photos of 4 objects resembling faces. You may not use objects that are supposed to look like animals or humans.

title: Name fifty women
description: It's as simple as it sounds. They must be real and alive women.

title: Copy Wikipedia
description: Search Wikipedia for a photograph taken of the local area. Take a photograph from the same location and angle.

title: Jog the perimeter
description: Jog around the entire perimeter of the region.

title: Bat a ball
description: Bat a ball. The ball must be thrown from a distance of at least 20 metres, and the bat may be anything, but must be no longer than 80cm and no wider than 10cm. Each teammate has three attempts. Please do this somewhere safe!

title: Make a daisy chain
description: Make a daisy chain necklace and photograph yourself wearing it.

title: Leave a review
description: Visit either the highest or lowest rated landmark in the area and write a review of it, making at least 2 points with photo evidence. You do not need to post the review.

title: Find a feather
description: Get a feather of any kind and take it here.

title: Become a weedkiller
description: Identify 10 plants as weeds and uproot them.

title: Shoot a hoop
description: Throw any round object through any circular ring

title: Find the sun and moon
description: Find either symbolic or photographic pictures of the sun and the moon.

title: Follow your destiny
description: Generate a random number from 1 to 92 then visit the region with that ID

title: Lure an opponent
description: Get an opponent to enter this region.

title: Quarter something
description: Split any object into four parts of equal shape and size.

title: Burst a bubble
description: Find or blow a bubble, and then pop it.

title: Limbo dilemma
description: Make a choice: succeed at a limbo below 60cm in 5 attempts, 90cm feet in 3 attempts, or 120cm in 1 attempt.

title: Cartography
description: Trace the shape of this region then colour it in. Be careful not to go over the lines!

title: Make it #aesthetic
description: Take a selection of 10 photos of the local area that encapsulate its aesthetic. Then apply a different filter on each one.

title: Draw in detail
description: Draw a building adjacent to your region. A teammate who is not present must correctly identify the building. Each teammate gets one guess. You may not write anything.

title: Total a menu
description: Find a menu and mentally calculate the total cost of every item on it. Check your answer with a calculator. If you were wrong, pick another menu and start over.

title: Write a rhyme
description: Compose a rhyme incorporating various product names from a local establishment. It must include at least 4 and be at least 8 lines long.

title: Describe something simply
description: One of you must go into a shop or park and describe something you can see with at most ten monosyllabic words. You may not identify the object directly. A teammate who is elsewhere must guess what you are describing.

title: Take a closer look
description: Take a photo of 3 items with the camera no more than 2cm from the subject. Your elsewhere teammates must then identify the things from these photos.

title: Point north
description: Without looking at any digital devices, determine and point in the direction of north. You must be within 15 degrees in either direction

title: Run for it
description: Reach any spawn point in 5 minutes.

title: Improve an advert
description: Find any advertisement and create your own advert for the same product. It must include the same factual information, such as price.

title: Celebrate a bus
description: Go to a bus stop where only one bus will arrive in the next five minutes. Wait for a bus to arrive, and chant "bus" when it appears.

title: Run a slalom
description: Place eight objects in a line, at least one metre apart each. Run from one end of the line to the other, alternating the side by which you pass each object. You have five seconds.

title: Leak your location
description: Reveal to all players your current location. Do this for the next two regions you enter.

title: Win at Wordle
description: Solve a Wordle puzzle from https://wordleunlimited.org/. You may only make one attempt per region. You may not complete this challenge more than once.

title: Play a round of hangman
description: Provide your team with an eight-letter word to guess. They can make at most six mistakes.

title: Make eighteen holes in one
description: Make 18 holes in any single object you find in this region.

title: Construct a pyramid
description: Stack six objects in a pyramid formation

title: Talk about transport
description: Get any stranger to say one of the following words: bus, train, plane, boat, car.

title: Gardening
description: Find some publicly accessible flowers and carefully water them.

title: Attempt divination
description: Guess which region your team will claim next. You may not inform your teammates of your guess. If you are incorrect, you must change your guess before trying again.

title: Irregulate your breathing
description: Start a stopwatch. In the next two minutes, you may only inhale when the timer shows a prime number of seconds. If you inhale any other time, start over.

title: Draw out a drawing
description: Draw one unbroken line at least 1 metre long without crossing over itself. You must verify the length.

title: Reach a lucky roll
description: Roll a die at least 3 metres and landing on at least 3

title: Test your luck
description: Predict five coin flips in a row. You may keep flipping until you succeed.

title: Rebrand your clothing
description: Create and attach a JL:OX branded tag to an article of clothing. If you ever lose the tag, you must return here to reattach it.

title: Touch grass
description: Sit on the ground whilst touching some live grass for at least 30 seconds. You've earned it.

title: Experience 3D rotations
description: Find a cuboidal object and take a photo of every face in four 90 degree rotations. Verify you have all 24 before continuing.

title: Balancing Act 2
description: Walk along the entire length of a kerb. You must start and end at different region boundaries. If you step off the kerb, start over.

title: Be at least 12 months old
description: Do each of the following: place a smaller thing into a larger container, wave at someone when they leave, use your thumb and pointer finger to pick up small objects, pull yourself up into a standing position

title: Tongue twisters
description: Look up three well-known tongue twisters and say them in quick succession with no mistakes.

title: Learn to juggle
description: Hold one object in each hand. Throw one into the air, and as it reaches the top of its arc, throw the second one. Catch the objects in opposite hands.

title: Competitive conversation
description: Talk to a stranger and time the length of your conversation. Then, talk to a second stranger for at least 50% longer. Conversations only count if they verbally respond.

title: Try not to Laugh
description: Find any video online with "try not to laugh" in its title. Watch at least two minutes of it, with sound, continuously, without laughing. If you laugh, you must restart from the beginning of the clip.

title: Jump for it
description: Travel at least 50m (total walking distance, not as the crow flies) without taking a step.

title: Spin like a champion
description: Create a spinning top which spins continuously for at least 30 seconds without assistance.

title: Report a problem to the council
description: Using https://fixmystreet.com, find an unreported issue and submit a proper report.

title: Bird guide
description: Take a continuous video of a bird lasting at least 60 seconds, without it leaving the frame

title: Parkour
description: Make a parkour video at least 30 seconds long, containing at leaast three stunts

title: Documentary
description: Film at 60 second documentary about this region of Oxford, with at least five shots, narration and a hand-drawn title card.

title: Wish you were here
description: Draw a postcard for this region of Oxford, spending at least 90 seconds on the drawing and writing at least 50 words on the back to your opponents.

title: Front page
description: Write (with a pen and a sheet of A4 paper!) a newspaper front page about this JL:OX event. It should have at least three articles of at least 50 words each, and one illustration.

title: Free advertising
description: Find an advertisement and copy its text word for word onto a piece of paper.

title: Balancing act
description: Balance on one leg for 90 seconds, touching nothing but the floor.
